sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1 from the constructionContractDate property shape. The requirement does not require every ship to provide exactly one contract date; it only applies the 2010 edition when an available contract date is on or after 2012-01-01 and before 2019-01-01. Retain the xsd:date datatype check and the conditional edition constraint so missing applicability evidence does not itself become noncompliance.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the exclusivity branch that reports any edition other than iceClassRegulationEdition2010 and remove “only” from the message; the requirement requires the 2010 edition to be applicable within the stated date interval but does not prohibit concurrent edition assertions. Also remove the unverified global sh:maxCount 1 contract-date rule (or treat date completeness/cardinality separately as readiness evidence), since the clause does not require every ship to have exactly one recorded contract date.

Declare the xsd prefix inside the sh:select SPARQL text (for example, add `PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>` before SELECT), or replace the prefixed date datatypes with full IRIs. Turtle prefix declarations are not automatically in scope within an embedded SHACL-SPARQL query.

Remove sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1 from the constructionContractDate property shape. The requirement does not require every ship to provide exactly one contract date; it only applies the 2010 edition when an available contract date is on or after 2012-01-01 and before 2019-01-01. Retain the xsd:date datatype check and the conditional edition constraint so missing applicability evidence does not itself become noncompliance.
